component.subject: Eucharist
component.title: Communion
component.source: John 6:35 adapted from the World English Bible (pronouns made inclusive). Response: Psalm 34:8 from the Common Coverdale Psalter (modern text, CC0), second half pluralised. Every spoken word is scripture.

original.p: John 6:35 (WEB): Jesus said to them, “I am the bread of life. He who comes to me will not be hungry, and he who believes in me will never be thirsty.”
Psalm 34:8 (Common Coverdale Psalter, modern): O taste and see how gracious the LORD is; * blessed is the one who trusts in him.

block.p: Jesus said to them, “I am the bread of life. Those who come to me will not be hungry, and the one who believes in me will never be thirsty.”

response.line: O taste and see how gracious the Lord is;
blessed are those who trust in him.

block.rubric: All eat and drink, in silence or with quiet music. If worshipping in a group, serve one another.
